This plot is not mine — I rent it, so I do not want to spend much cash on it. I never went to school, and I farm the way my father did and the way my neighbors do. I have five hectares in total to worry about, so this rented plot gets less of my money and attention. I will put some of my cattle manure on it because I have animals, and I will plant the seed I saved from last harvest. Fertilizer from the cooperative is expensive and comes late, and on a rented plot I do not want to risk the cash. I will do the work myself with my family, and maybe call one or two neighbors for a day when it is time to weed.
